policy.preserved: Both binaries must match candidate observations.
policy.intentional-acceptance: Baseline rejection or old behavior is historical evidence; candidate must execute target observations.
policy.intentional-rejection: Candidate must reject for the stated semantic boundary after parsing; baseline parser/type omission rejection is pending, never a semantic pass.
policy.execution: Run each source independently with the ordinary xsh CLI; check with xsht check. Native target tests assert candidate observations and deliberately fail on an old compiler.

cases.reason: Explicit value and success boundaries retain Bool, Unit, Optional and nested Result values.
Existing private pure inference returns false and preserves Result data.
Written Unit and Result[Unit] boundaries select assertion; try captures exactly once.
A concrete non-tail Bool asserts before a value tail.
Explicit discard does not assert or propagate the resulting value.
Discard retains explicit initializer propagation and cleanup.
Established Result[Unit] proc statement propagation remains implicit.
An explicit Int proc keeps its data API and out-of-band error channel.
try returns Result data as nested success, captures explicit propagation, and retains a Bool value tail.
Return inside retry targets the enclosing callable and runs attempt cleanup.
Captured blocks retain lexical continue/break targets without manufacturing values.
Callback Bool remains data and map keeps Result items instead of propagating them.
Supplied slots run in source order; omitted defaults run once in parameter order and use outer lexical names.
Producer creation is lazy, supplied values eager, omitted defaults first-pull, and cancellation cleans child before parent.
